title: Peckern
safeHtml:
'''Peckern''' is one of the main areas of Los Sengas, and it is located to the west of the West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA). The representative color of Peckern in Los Sengas is Green, and the District Number is 7. This district is located within the Peckern Continent, and is currently managed by DaOrangeStoneOre.

On January 15 2017, this district had a brief merger with Peckern North, and the area was shrunk to the east of '''Peckern Forest'''. However, as of right now, Peckern North and Peckern are two separate districts, with the west boundary of this district extending to Intus Occident once again. With this in mind, these two districts are now separate by Yan Shing Road. After January 2020, the Peckern Government has drawn the area of Treeless Hill and Milead Pond as the South Peckern Sub-District to give a clearer boundary of development.

On January 8 2021, the boundary of Peckern and Peckern North has been redrawn, with Peckern District extending to the south of Route 12 and the entire Heart Peninsula, meaning that the Peckern Government now manages all past development areas in Peckern Continent.

On May 4 2022, the northwestern part of Airship Island became a part of this district, and the entire Airship Island became a part of this district on May 6 2023.

title: Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport
safeHtml:
'''Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport''', formally named '''Los Sengas Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport''' and commonly abbreviated as '''Peckern North Eternal Airport'''The abbreviation is taken from its location Peckern North and took the shorter word "Eternal" instead of "Eternity"</ref>, is a proposed airport in Peckern North.

Description

  • Area: Approximately 6.677 km2
  • Passenger Termini: 1, with two wings
  • Runways: 2, One 4200m long and one 3500m long
  • Helipads: N/A
  • Boarding Gates: Approximately 40

This airport formerly crosses three different districts, namely the north of Festival, the west of Peckern North and the southeast of Goldpoint. The relocated airport is planned to be located to the north of Northern Dansein New Town, which would become the auxiliary town of this airport. Plans of this airport also included the Route 12A extension and appurtenant works near Fall Point Gateway.

History

This airport was originally named '''Alice Margatroid Airport''' after the Touhou Project character of the Same Name. At the time, this airport had a passenger terminal, 51 boarding gates, and a runway that has yet to be marked. However, due to historical reasons, the Original builder of the airport left Project Nazca, and while the player who took over airport development also refurbished parts of the passenger terminal, the involvement of another Peckern North developer had meant that the airport would be relocated. As a result, the Old Airport Structure is completely demolished and now forms part of the Northwest Stadiums Area.

After relocation, several suggestions have been given regarding the new name of the airport, such as:

  • Great Grundorf Airport, and
  • Peckern Continent Eternal Soaring International AirportThe English Name of this variant was deviated from the Chinese Name.</ref>

To compliment airport relocation, Temporary Traffic Regulations have been put in place. Firstly, Route 12 have undergone reconstruction to compliment Northwest Stadiums Area development, and the carriageway have also widened to compliment Route 412 construction. In terms of Railways, a Station of the same name as the airport is demolished as it shared structures with the original Airport Passenger Terminal. Currently, services currently only ran between Senriyama Station and Water Beach Station, with stations to the west of suspending services until further notice.

The location of the airport completed reclamation works on January 8 2024 and began construction on the same day.

'''Peckern North''' is one of the Districts of Los Sengas. It is located to the west of the West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA) and to the north of Peckern. The representative color of Peckern in Los Sengas is Dark Green, and the District Number is 8. Similar to Peckern, this district is also located within the Peckern Continent, and is also currently managed by DaOrangeStoneOre.

This district had briefly merged with Peckern from January 15 2017. However, on March 4 2018, this district once again became a district on its own and became District Number 8 due to rapid development from Senriyama (Now a part of Peckern District). On January 8 2021, after redrawing its border with Peckern, it now became a separate District to manage newest development in North Peckern Continent. safeHtml:
'''Pisces Pond''' was a lake in Los Sengas. Its vicinity has defined the Pisces Pond Sub-District.

Geography

Pisces Pond consisted of two lakes, and has also formed its namesake. However, one of the lakes was covered by roads due to subsequent development, and only one of them is left.

The natural terrain of this area is unidentifiable. What is known was that there used to be two lakes. Another lake that received similar treatment is Origin Pond.

  • The Station Title of this Station is '''Radiant Lunar'''.
  • This Stations features The Cuisine, and the Station Menu is "Beef Sliders with Pickles and Mustard".
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Gleams Between the Rails".

Fun Facts

  • This Station is the first station in Nazca Railway to be set up on an isle-class island. While railways were originally forbidden on isle-class islands, that rule was for Island Owners only, and at the time of the setting up of this rule, islands to the north of Northtip Island have not been found yet.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JbPxxXLQcgc&t=2370s</ref>
  • This Station adopts the Station Design and color schemes from Grensis Island Station and Finnick Station at the same time. While the Southern Part of this station (The Side closer to Grensis Island) uses Green and building materials from Grensis Island Station, the Northern Part of this station (The Side closer to The Finnick Island) uses Red and Black with building materials from Finnick Station. In other words, this station does not have its own color. This design is due to the fact that the owner of Platform Isle at the time was indecisive regarding the style of this station.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JbPxxXLQcgc&t=2452s</ref>
  • Despite being built and having completed construction at the same time as Finnick Station, as this station was connected by tracks earlier than Finnick Station, the station number of this station is smaller than that of Finnick Station.
  • This Station does '''NOT''' feature platform passageways.
  • The Stairs of this station resemble shapes of spaghetti due to lack of underground space and the irregularity of the island shape.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JbPxxXLQcgc&t=2643s</ref>
  • One of the walls of the Station Control Room at the South Concourses uses characteristics from the North Concourse.
